Here is the issue description:
# [bug, dbg] Don't cache instruction whilst in debug mode lowrisc/ibex#1472
CHERIoT Ibex does not disable the instruction cache when in debug mode, leading to incorrect behaviour. This was previously discovered and fixed in upstream Ibex in 2021-2022.
See [lowRISC Ibex issue 1472](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/issues/1472) for details on the problem and [lowRISC Ibex commit 7b1be33](https://github.com/lowRISC/ibex/commit/7b1be3354d650bc5b23dff6f439459c353288e4f) for the fix implemented.

Good catch — this bug is almost certainly in the **instruction-fetch path around debug-mode state propagation**.

### Why this happens (likely causes)

From the issue and upstream reference, the failure mode is typically:

1. **Core enters debug mode**, but fetch still uses the I-cache path.
2. A debugger may patch memory / single-step / redirect PC, while cached lines remain valid.
3. Since cache is still active, instruction fetch can return stale or wrong instructions.
4. CHERIoT fork likely diverged before/around upstream fix, so one or more of:
   - debug-mode signal not propagated to IF/cache,
   - icache not force-disabled/bypassed in debug mode,
   - icache invalidation/flush not triggered on debug entry,
   - top-level wrappers missing new/updated signal wiring.

Given that, the most likely edits are in IF stage, icache, controller/debug state generation, and top-level wiring files (including CHERIoT top variants).

Most likely 10 files:

```text
rtl/ibex_if_stage.sv
rtl/ibex_icache.sv
rtl/ibex_controller.sv
rtl/ibex_core.sv
rtl/ibex_prefetch_buffer.sv
rtl/ibex_fetch_fifo.sv
rtl/ibex_top.sv
rtl/ibex_top_tracing.sv
rtl/ibexc_top.sv
rtl/ibexc_top_tracing.sv
```
